types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker / 2P / 16 A / C curve / base breaker

document.title: Multi 9 — Sistema apparecchiature modulari
document.pages: Printed pp.14-15; viewer pages 16-17; diagram E45094

modelingNotes: Schneider-authored Italian Multi 9 catalog 2010-2011, mirrored by carnevale.bz on Yumpu. Printed p.15 (viewer page 17) explicitly lists 24270 under 2P, 16 A, C curve; adjacent diagram E45094 establishes terminals 1-2 and 3-4 and mechanical ganging. Page images were visually reviewed.

Base breaker only. Four cage terminals; auxiliary contacts, releases and Vigi add-ons are separately selected hardware and are not included. No PE, shield, return or communication connection appears in the base breaker circuit diagram.

16 A rated current at 30 degrees C; C-curve magnetic operation 5-10 times In. Printed p.14 gives Ue 400 V AC, Ui 500 V AC and Uimp 6 kV. These capabilities are not an assigned circuit voltage; nominal_voltage and voltage_type are omitted.

For 2P: Icn 6000 A at 400 V under CEI EN 60898; Icu 20 kA at 230-240 V and 10 kA at 400-415 V under CEI EN 60947-2. Conditional breaking capacities remain notes. DC use and installation coordination were not established.
For this 16 A rating, cage terminals accept cable up to 16 mm2 flexible or 25 mm2 rigid (printed p.14). Shared connection policy does not establish permitted multiple-conductor combinations.

Contact functions depict the open state shown in diagram E45094, not an installed handle position. Neither contacts nor ganging create permanent net continuity. No fixed links. Terminal use is application-dependent; none is universally required.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four base-breaker power terminals 1, 2, 3, 4, documented by exact-order selection table and 2P diagram E45094. No built-in auxiliary, PE, shield or communication terminals; separately selected accessories excluded.
